graph.name: Suggest a memory from a cue
graph.description:
Use a present sensory cue to appraise supplied past episodes and suggest a memory to mention.

Lesson: Reflect Recall connects a present cue to supplied saved episode IDs. Express Attention turns that assessment into direction for a brief recollection without creating an episode or inventing its contents.

Limitations: One model appraises all supplied bounded episodes. There is no semantic index or automatic external lorebook reader.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Change the present cue from lamp oil to wet rope; compare whether Recall finds a supplied episode or honestly offers no supported connection.
In a copy, change Memory Read Episodes to Recall with Query 'lamp oil harbor father' and Results 3; compare the supplied episode set before the same one-call assessment.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Cue and saved episode: The ferry smells of lamp oil. A stored episode recalls waiting at the old harbor beside her father.

Attention brief: A brief harbor recollection may color the pause. Reference the stored episode; do not invent a new memory.

Scoped evidence → recall → attention: Wire Scene→Reflect context and Express context; Episodes→Reflect episodes and Express episodes; Reflect→Express assessment; Express→Guidance. Keep Memory in the root; one model appraises the supplied episode set.

Demo prerequisite and reuse: Keep Reflect and Express visible as separate nodes in this lesson. After lesson 28, the processing pair can be reused behind typed boundaries while sources and Guidance remain root.

Local model and memory limits: Analysis resolves locally. This example has no semantic index, lorebook reader or autonomous flashback trigger. A cue connection remains an interpretation, and absent saved evidence should produce no invented recollection.

Lamp oil on the ferry (pre-scene)
Purpose: Read four recent exchanges and Mira's card so the present sensation stays specific and immediate.
Fixture: Character: Mira is the focal narrator; recollections may color a pause. Chat: The ferry cabin smells of lamp oil. Mira waits by its window while the player decides whether to board. No flashback has been narrated.
Inspect: Confirm the present cue is explicitly supplied. Scene Context reads host material and does not fetch a lorebook or manufacture a sensory detail.

Saved old-harbor episode (pre-episodes)
Purpose: Read the native Episodes view for the active host actor so Recall receives scoped, versioned past evidence.
Fixture: Demo prerequisite: select Mira and supply an existing supported saved episode of waiting at the old harbor beside her father, with lamp oil explicitly mentioned. Plain JSON cannot supply this scoped record; importing the example never seeds live memory.
Inspect: Inspect the actual episode IDs/text and record scope/version. Read has no Query or Results setting; use Recall mode in a copy to bound a stored search instead.

Present cue, supplied past (pre-reflect)
Purpose: Use one Analysis request to create Reflection Data connecting only supplied episodes to the current sensation.
Inspect: Inspect recalledEpisodeIds against the input and check attentionHints for unsupported details. Unwired State uses empty scoped state, not stored traits; Episodes still carries the supplied past evidence.

Brief recollection attention (pre-express)
Purpose: Render the assessment's attentionHints as Guidance without another model call, using matching Episodes and Context for evidence checks.
Inspect: Expect attentionHints joined verbatim. Instructions and Output tokens are inactive in Attention. Wire the same Episodes and Scene here so recalled IDs and evidence remain checkable.

Cue-linked memory direction (pre-guidance)
Purpose: Deliver a small optional recollection brief that returns to the present and leaves the player's action unresolved.
Inspect: Inspect the Host result for a cited supplied episode or an honest present-only fallback. This root Pre graph does not add episodes or call an external memory index.

pre-reflect.title: Reflect · recall
pre-reflect.instructions: Connect the present lamp-oil smell to a supplied past episode only when its text supports that cue. Cite only supplied episode IDs in recalledEpisodeIds. Put a concise direction in attentionHints: a brief harbor recollection may color Mira's pause, then return to the ferry cabin. Distinguish present observation from recalled evidence and interpretation. Do not invent her father's dialogue, weather, age, a new episode, or a memory when none is supplied. Leave the player's boarding decision open. If there is no supported match, keep attention on the present smell.
